deep.reconstruction:
This page is almost blank, and nothing on it is a finished argument. It has a single line at the top that has been struck through, plus a small boxed doodle below it.

The struck line most likely reads 'Cas de S = Spec ℂ 6.4(5?). Soit X un espace (?) analytique. ...'. It is an abandoned first start of section 6.5. The next page restarts that section properly, under the marginal heading 'Cas S = Spec ℂ'.

The surrounding pages give the context. Page 66 discusses the Čech-Alexander-type complexes F^(ν) built from formal neighbourhoods of the diagonal X^{ν+1}_{/X}. For the stratifying ring O_{X_Strat} and the crystalline ring O_{X_cris}, these are coinduced rings on X_Zar. Their coboundaries are differential operators of infinite order. Page 68 compares the crystalline cohomology of the structure sheaf over ℂ with the analytic stratifying (de Rham-type) cohomology. It uses the spectral sequence E_2^{pq} = H^p(ν ↦ H^q(X^{ν+1}_{/X}, O)), Mittag-Leffler for proper X, and GAGA on the infinitesimal neighbourhoods Δ^(ν)(i).

The abandoned line apparently started instead from an analytic space X, before Grothendieck chose to begin algebraically with X proper over ℂ and pass to the analytic side via GAGA.

The sketch is a trapezoid/box containing zigzag strokes, with tick marks and a small word along its bottom edge. It has no labels from which mathematical content could be reliably extracted. One might guess at an infinitesimal neighbourhood or a staircase/spectral-sequence picture, but this is speculative.

ideas.what: Abandoned start of the comparison of crystalline (infinitesimal) cohomology of O with analytic cohomology for S = Spec ℂ; this is carried out on the next page.
ideas.modern_name: Comparison of infinitesimal/crystalline cohomology with analytic de Rham cohomology in characteristic 0 (Grothendieck's 'On the de Rham cohomology of algebraic varieties', Crystals and de Rham cohomology)
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'Crystals and the de Rham cohomology of schemes' in Dix exposés sur la cohomologie des schémas (1968); 'On the de Rham cohomology of algebraic varieties', Publ. IHES 29 (1966)

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries only a crossed-out false start, repeated on the next page, and an unlabeled doodle; there is no mathematical content beyond what neighbouring pages and published texts contain.
transcription_corrections: The struck line probably begins 'Cas de S = Spec ℂ 6.4.' (a marginal-style heading, later restated as 'Cas S = Spec ℂ' / 6.5 on p. 68) rather than 'Cardin[?] = Spec[?] 6.4.'
The rest of the struck line is plausibly 'Soit X un espace ... analytique. Bon[?]' rather than 'Sur[?] X ... ... analytique. ...'; the 'X' is a large crossed letter.
